protect_ledger.payoff: real - blocked Incineroar's Flare Blitz (Fire, 2x into Bug/Electric), which was very likely a KO; Galvantula survived at full HP and went on to score two KOs

ai_observations: Galvantula's turn-1 Protect against a Fire attacker is the decision that turned this from a sweep into a two-faint fight.
could_this_be_cooler: Mega Heracross has now failed to act in both runs because it arrives last against a healthy Mega Metagross. A negative offset would make that worse; what it needs is to arrive earlier or behind a Protect body, which is a composition question rather than a level one. Noted, not changed.
